fun_facts: Jalen Tolbert was born in Mobile, Alabama.
In his final season at South Alabama, he caught 82 passes for 1,474 yards and scored eight times.
In one South Alabama game, Jalen Tolbert had 169 receiving yards and two touchdowns.
In 2024, Jalen Tolbert caught a game-winning touchdown pass with 20 seconds left in a Cowboys win over the Steelers.

excerpts:
A hamstring injury in the spring and an overload in what he was asked to do offensively led to a crisis in confidence for Tolbert as a rookie. He spent some of the offseason at the Senior Bowl offices studying his old tape from South Alabama, where he caught 82 passes for 1,474 yards and eight scores in his final season. He also joined Prescott at the hip.

That has continued this offseason.

excerpts: Prescott threw the winning touchdown pass -- a 4-yarder to receiver [Jalen Tolbert](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4249417/jalen-tolbert) \-- with 20 seconds left to give the Cowboys a crucial 20-17 win against the Steelers. It allowed the Cowboys (3-2) to stay above .500 and on the tail of the [Washington Commanders](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/wsh/washington-commanders) (4-1) in the NFC East. It also was the Cowboys' third road win of the season, marking their best start away from home since Prescott's rookie year in 2016.
